sloka: सा तथा उक्त्वा महा राजम् कौसल्या शोक लालसा ।धरण्याम् निपपात आशु बाष्प विप्लुत भाषिणी ॥२-५७-३२॥
transliteration: sā tathā uktvā mahā rājam kausalyā śoka lālasā ।dharaṇyām nipapāta āśu bāṣpa vipluta bhāṣiṇī ॥2-57-32॥

translations.english: Absorbed in grief, Kausalya spoke to the maharaja in a voice choked with tears and then collapsed on the floor.
